name: afo-public-website
description: Public landing page for AFO (AI Front Office for service businesses) at proportion.systems.

scripts.check: node build.mjs && node tools/check.mjs && node tools/public-payment-check.mjs
scripts.screenshots: node build.mjs && node tools/screenshots.mjs && SHOWCASE_STATE=live node build.mjs && SHOTS_DIR=docs/screenshots/live-state node tools/screenshots.mjs && node build.mjs
scripts.copy: node build.mjs && node tools/extract-copy.mjs && SHOWCASE_STATE=live PHONE_LINE=pending node build.mjs && COPY_STATE=live node tools/extract-copy.mjs && node build.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run a11y && npm run stage && npm run perf
